m04PullRequest.body:
## Handoff only. Do not merge yet.
This draft preserves partial M04 with all flags off. Start with [the handoff](docs/implementation/v3/M04-handoff.md) and the [PARTIAL evidence receipt](docs/implementation/v3/M04-verification.json).

Implemented: deterministic context core and admitted host metadata, owned Hermes deferred-schema enforcement, bounded catalog-result custody, Context Inspector evidence, and tested draft source-pin helpers. Native compaction stays unsupported where safe application is unavailable.

Next: wire the composer, finish adapter/history integration, classify remaining failures against the unchanged base, and verify exact-head acceptance. The export/source inventory is unchanged in this draft and needs review and registration before packaging.

The prior offline candidate passed 121 focused tests and 21 Chromium tests. Full local regression was not green; some failures reproduce on the unchanged base. No live-provider, release, or merge claim.
